content: The Founder reads the list standing, then signs his initials at the bottom of the board with the marker, which is his idea of ceremony. 'This is the order. I own number 4 and I'll be measured on it like everyone else.'
round_time: Morning, Day 5 - Decisions I: the ranked priority list

decisions.text: Founder approves the ranked priority list as final call

content: Head of Product reads it out. '1. F1 dead-seed bundle: Plant and CX, with Designer on the card and Ops on storage. 2. F2 public remedy promise: CX, reviewed by Legal through the professional pack, capped by Finance. 3. F3 buffered dispatch date and weekly updates: Ops and CX. 4. F5 Archive 002 product, price and the launch gate: Founder decides, Finance sets price guardrails, I run the gate. 5. F4 spec card, payment method, size rule: Designer, Ops, Finance. 6. F6 trust stack: Brand and Community on hands content, Legal on business details, CX on named support. 7. F7 proof registry, rumours post and hook rules: Community and Growth, Legal rules. 8. F9 segment evidence and survey review: Research, with the Founder. 9. F8 identity line, unboxing and framing test: Brand and Designer. Logic: fix what kills repeat, then what blocks a safe launch, then what grows it. Everything on this list ships in 30 days. The rank decides what gets protected when time runs short.'
round_time: Morning, Day 5 - Decisions I: the ranked priority list

decisions.text: RANKED PRIORITY LIST: 1 F1 dead-seed bundle (PP1; Plant + CX; Designer card, Ops storage); 2 F2 public remedy promise (PP2; CX; Legal review; Finance cap); 3 F3 buffered dispatch date + weekly updates (PP9; Ops + CX); 4 F5 Archive 002 product/price + launch gate (PP3; Founder decides; Finance guardrail; HoP gate); 5 F4 spec card, payment method, size rule (PP5; Designer + Ops + Finance); 6 F6 trust stack (PP4; Brand + Community; Legal; CX); 7 F7 proof registry, rumours post, hook rules (PP6; Community + Growth; Legal); 8 F9 segment evidence + survey review (PP8; Research + Founder); 9 F8 identity line, unboxing, framing test (PP7; Brand + Designer)
